label: Four-case models: sharp union bound, cancelling errors, and a gap concentrated on the hard case
paraphrase: In four equally weighted stipulated cases: (1) a selection error 1/4 and a factor/truth gap 1/4 on different cases give agreement exactly 1/2, attaining the union bound; (2) the same two rates on the same case give agreement 1; (3) with the judgment equal to the factor (selection error 0) and a gap of 1/4 located in the one impartial hard case, aggregate agreement is 3/4, attaining the bound, while agreement conditioned on the hard case is 0 and on the three adaptive cases 1; the gap conditioned on the hard case is 1, equal to the aggregate gap divided by the hard-case weight. The verdicts are stipulations, not claims about actual moral truths or actual frequencies.
